styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Dim sum mornings, roast goose and late-night Cantonese.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Chen Clan Ancestral Hall, Cantonese opera and the Pearl River.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Shamian Island, the old town and the Sun Yat-sen sites.

stays.why: Modern towers, Canton Tower views and the best metro links; good for first-timers.
Big shopping malls, many mid-range hotels and easy metro access to the whole city.
Old-city centre: parks, markets and cheap eats within walking distance.
Quiet tree-lined streets with colonial buildings; a calm base near the river.

food: Start the day with dim sum (yum cha): har gow, siu mai and rice rolls. Go before 10am on weekends or expect a queue.
Try Cantonese roast meats: roast goose, char siu and soy chicken, often sold from small shopfronts at lunch.
Wonton noodles and congee are cheap, filling staples; a bowl is often under ¥30.
Evening dai pai dong and seafood streets are lively; point at what looks fresh and ask the price first.
Drink tea with meals. Tap water is not for drinking; bottled water is cheap everywhere.
more_time: Add a day trip to Foshan for Cantonese martial-arts history and ceramics; trains from Guangzhou South take under an hour.
Ferries run to Hong Kong and Macau from Nansha and Lianhuashan ports; check times and tickets on the day.
Spend a slow morning in Yuexiu Park and the Chen Clan Ancestral Hall if you want more old-city time.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the old city, Shamian and a proper dim sum morning; add a night for day trips or shopping.

month_notes: Coolest month: highs near 19°C, lows near 11°C. Bring a jacket for evenings.
Mild and dry-ish: highs around 21°C, about 9 rain days. Good walking weather.
Warms up to 24°C with more rain (about 15 days). Carry an umbrella.
Warm and wet: highs near 27°C, around 17 rain days. Expect humid afternoons.
Hot and rainy: highs near 30°C, about 22 rain days. Plan indoor breaks.
Peak rain: highs near 31°C, around 26 rain days. Thunderstorms are common.
Hot and humid: highs near 32°C, still about 22 rain days. Go out early or late.
Similar to July: highs near 32°C, around 25 rain days. Stay hydrated.
Still hot at 31°C but rain eases to about 20 days. Typhoon season; check forecasts.
Comfort returns: highs near 28°C, only about 8 rain days. Great month to visit.
Pleasant and dry: highs near 25°C, around 6 rain days. Ideal for sightseeing.
Cool and dry: highs near 20°C, about 5 rain days. Pack a light coat.

climate_guide.summary: Subtropical and humid: hot, wet summers and mild, drier winters.

items.title: Best time: October to December
items.text: Highs of 20–28°C with few rain days. Comfortable for walking and outdoor sights.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (June to September)
items.text: Highs around 31–32°C and lows near 25–26°C. Muggy days; take indoor breaks.

items.title: Wettest months: May to August
items.text: Around 22–26 rain days a month. Short heavy showers; carry an umbrella.

items.title: Typhoon season
items.text: Late summer and autumn can bring storms. Check forecasts before day trips.

items.title: Cool, dry winters
items.text: January and February drop to 11–12°C at night. A jacket helps in the evening.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light breathable clothes and rain gear in summer; a light layer for winter nights; comfortable shoes for walking.

transit.best: Metro for almost everything: cheap, fast and signed in English.

modes.text: 15+ lines, fares ¥2–21, English signs. Tap a foreign contactless card or buy a token. A Yang Cheng Tong card costs ¥50 (¥18 deposit) and gives 5–40% discounts.
Cheap and wide-reaching but slower and harder to read for visitors.
Metered taxis. DiDi and Amap work; Uber does not operate in China.
Not advised for visitors: heavy traffic and different rules.
Good in the centre; shared bikes are common for short hops.
Ferries run to Hong Kong and Macau from Nansha and Lianhuashan ports.
